review.tagline: Python multi-physics simulator for robotics and physical AI research
review.summary: Genesis World is a Python simulation platform that combines a multi-physics engine (rigid, FEM, MPM, PBD, SPH, IPC, SAP), three renderers (Nyx, Luisa, Pyrender) and the Quadrants compiler. Quadrants lowers Python kernels to CUDA, ROCm, Metal, Vulkan, x86 and ARM64. It loads URDF, MJCF, OBJ, GLB and USD assets, and supports parallel and heterogeneous environments, sensors and a built-in GUI.
review.audience: Robotics and RL researchers who need a Python physics simulator
strengths: Rigid, FEM, MPM, SPH, PBD and IPC solvers share one scene and state
Quadrants compiles to CUDA, ROCm, Metal, Vulkan, x86 and ARM64
Many runnable examples: sensors, controllers, domain randomization, heterogeneous envs
Parses URDF, MJCF, OBJ, GLB and USD assets
weaknesses: IPC solver needs pyuipc on Linux or Windows x86 with an NVIDIA GPU
PyTorch must be installed separately before the package
Nyx renderer is a separate package (gs-nyx) with its own install
needs: Models: URDF, MJCF, OBJ, GLB, USD
